title: Trevor Grassi's corridor of rooms leading to the tunnel network
place_text: Giza Plateau, near the shafts between Khafre and the Sphinx, Egypt

tellings.quote: 100 m far away from these shafts and he found and he found a so-called corridor of rooms.

plain: A scientist named Filippo Biondi, who has scanned beneath the pyramids of Egypt, told podcast host Jesse Michels about work by a man named Trevor Grassi on the Giza Plateau. Biondi says Grassi found what is called a corridor of rooms about 100 meters from some shafts that lie between the pyramid of Khafre and the Sphinx, leading toward a network of tunnels. If true, it would mean there is much more built underground at Giza than people know.
